title: Rival 32 Ounce Hot Pot Express
text: Rival 32 Ounce Hot Pot Express. It is one of those items I use on daily basis, heat soup, hot dogs, makes hot water quicker than the Microwave for tea and coffe etc. I even take it with me on vacation for hot tea or soups to heat. A niffty product.

product_metadata.title: Rival 4071-WN 32-Ounce Hot Pot Express, White
features: Nonstick interior surface wipes clean with soap and water
Cooks soups, noodles, mac & cheese and much more
description: Great for cooking soups, noodles, vegetables, and much more. The Hot Pot boils water up to 60% faster than a microwave and it's easy to clean non-stick cooking surface.

A real time-saver, this 32-ounce Hot Pot boils water 60 percent faster than a microwave. The plain white exterior makes it equally at home in an office or dorm room, and the nonstick interior can be wiped out easily with a soapy sponge (the pot should never be immersed in water). Seven settings, from low to high, allow milk to gently warm or noodle soups to come to a full boil. A one-year warranty covers the pot against defects.
